capabilities: Start, stop, and build the Retype documentation server from a sidebar panel
Detect the nearest retype.yml project and the Retype CLI on the system PATH
Install the Retype CLI with one click via npm, yarn, or dotnet
Stream color-coded CLI console output and show live server status with a clickable URL
Configure license key, rebuild debounce, and browser or status bar options in settings
disambiguation: Not a typing or text-input tool; it runs the Retype static documentation generator on your vault.
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Windows, Linux). The README warns that automated plugin scans may report shell execution warnings because the plugin launches the local Retype CLI.
intentEvidence: Install and manage Retype directly from your Obsidian vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run Retype's documentation build and preview server against vault content without leaving the app and using the terminal.

relations.evidence: Build and preview your documentation with Retype.

requires.name: Retype Pro or Community license key

summary: Sidebar panel that runs the Retype documentation generator from inside Obsidian, starting a preview server and building docs for the detected project.
